issues.detail: The Greek 'ου μη με ιδητε' is a double negative (ou + mē) which functions as an emphatic negative, meaning 'you will not see me.' The Vietnamese translation 'các ngươi sẽ không thấy ta nữa' adds the word 'nữa' (anymore/no longer), which is not present in the Greek text. While it captures the sense of future absence, 'nữa' implies a cessation of a current state, whereas the Greek focuses on the future non-occurrence.
